instruction: A candid action photograph captured from a medium, slightly high angle shows an indoor martial arts studio with wooden floors and a black mat. On the right, the man in the white gi (R1) is kneeling and leaning forward in a dominant grappling posture. On the left, the man in the gray gi (R2) lies on his back with his knees bent. The man in the white gi (R1) leans over the man in the gray gi (R2), gripping his upper body, while the man in the gray gi (R2) holds his partner's arms defensively. Bright natural light streams from background windows, casting warm tones and soft shadows across the scene.
elements: R1 kneels and leans forward over R2 in a dominant grappling posture
R2 lies on his back with knees bent beneath R1
R1 grips R2's upper body while R2 holds R1's arms defensively
R2 is the person being controlled from above rather than the person on top
a black mat is part of the grappling area
